name: Gas export / reinforcement centrifugal compressor train
description: Raises gas pressure for export pipeline or reservoir reinjection. Integrally geared and multistage centrifugal machines cover high-volume pipeline/process duty; drivers are electric motors or steam/gas turbines, with dry gas seals and oil systems as auxiliaries.
